findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 211 requests to 9 third-party domains (median of 4 passes).
Of 3.9 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 3.6 MB (95%) came from third-party domains, 92 kB of it from services classified as tracking (8 requests).

5 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: chartbeat.com (Chartbeat, analytics), chartbeat.net (Chartbeat, analytics), dotmetrics.net (Ipsos (Dotmetrics), audience measurement), googlesyndication.com (Google, advertising), scorecardresearch.com (Comscore, audience measurement).
2 cookies were set by third-party domains (18 cookies in total).

After the banner's reject button (“I do not agree”) was pressed, 8 tracking services were contacted in the following 12 seconds, 5 of them not seen before the click (adtrafficquality.google, cxense.com, doubleclick.net, doubleverify.com, dv.tech). Before the click: 5. Third-party cookies went from 2 to 4 (median of 2 passes). The consent tool appeared to be Sourcepoint.

After the banner's accept button (“I agree”) was pressed, 49 tracking services were contacted in the following 12 seconds, 46 of them not seen before the click (360yield.com, 3lift.com, adform.net, adnxs.com, adsrvr.org, adtrafficquality.google, amazon-adsystem.com, bidr.io). Before the click: 5. Third-party cookies went from 2 to 79 (median of 2 passes). The consent tool appeared to be Sourcepoint.
